items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Tats Matsuo was the owner of Lai Yi Chai's, and I formed a six-piece band

ctx.x: That was all you stayed in that one...

Well, that wiped it out. No, I stayed. The rest of the guys came back. Trummy stayed until he went with Louis years later. So I stayed, and then I came back and I decided to go back; I went back and played with the symphony. I stayed with the symphony for about three years, and meanwhile I had my own band, working at Lai Yi Chai's, which was probably the hippest Chinese restaurant you ever saw, run by Japanese.
